329:   def pbAbleCount(idxBattler = 0)
330:     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
331:     count = 0
332:     party.each { |pkmn| count += 1 if pkmn&.able? }
333:     return count

336:   def pbAbleNonActiveCount(idxBattler = 0)
337:     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
338:     inBattleIndices = allSameSideBattlers(idxBattler).map { |b| b.pokemonIndex }
339:     count = 0
340:     party.each_with_index do |pkmn, idxParty|
341:       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
342:       next if inBattleIndices.include?(idxParty)
343:       count += 1
344:     end
345:     return count
346:   end

348:   def pbAllFainted?(idxBattler = 0)

352:   def pbTeamAbleNonActiveCount(idxBattler = 0)
353:     inBattleIndices = allSameSideBattlers(idxBattler).map { |b| b.pokemonIndex }
354:     count = 0
355:     eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler) do |pkmn, i|
356:       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
357:       next if inBattleIndices.include?(i)

363:   # For the given side of the field (0=player's, 1=opponent's), returns an array
364:   # containing the number of able Pokémon in each team.
365:   def pbAbleTeamCounts(side)
366:     party = pbParty(side)
367:     partyStarts = pbPartyStarts(side)
368:     ret = []
369:     idxTeam = -1
370:     nextStart = 0
371:     party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
372:       if i >= nextStart
373:         idxTeam += 1
374:         nextStart = (idxTeam < partyStarts.length - 1) ? partyStarts[idxTeam + 1] : party.length
375:       end
376:       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?
377:       ret[idxTeam] = 0 if !ret[idxTeam]
378:       ret[idxTeam] += 1
379:     end
380:     return ret
381:   end

383:   #=============================================================================
384:   # Get team information (a team is only the Pokémon owned by a particular
385:   # trainer)
386:   #=============================================================================
387:   def pbTeamIndexRangeFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
388:     partyStarts = pbPartyStarts(idxBattler)
389:     idxTrainer = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
390:     idxPartyStart = partyStarts[idxTrainer]
391:     idxPartyEnd   = (idxTrainer < partyStarts.length - 1) ? partyStarts[idxTrainer + 1] : pbParty(idxBattler).length
392:     return idxPartyStart, idxPartyEnd
393:   end
394: 
395:   def pbTeamLengthFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
396:     idxPartyStart, idxPartyEnd = pbTeamIndexRangeFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
397:     return idxPartyEnd - idxPartyStart
398:   end

400:   def eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
401:     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
402:     idxPartyStart, idxPartyEnd = pbTeamIndexRangeFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
403:     party.each_with_index { |pkmn, i| yield pkmn, i if pkmn && i >= idxPartyStart && i < idxPartyEnd }
404:   end

406:   def eachInTeam(side, idxTrainer)
407:     party       = pbParty(side)
408:     partyStarts = pbPartyStarts(side)
409:     idxPartyStart = partyStarts[idxTrainer]
410:     idxPartyEnd   = (idxTrainer < partyStarts.length - 1) ? partyStarts[idxTrainer + 1] : party.length
411:     party.each_with_index { |pkmn, i| yield pkmn, i if pkmn && i >= idxPartyStart && i < idxPartyEnd }
412:   end

414:   # Used for Illusion.
415:   # NOTE: This cares about the temporary rearranged order of the team. That is,
416:   #       if you do some switching, the last Pokémon in the team could change
417:   #       and the Illusion could be a different Pokémon.
418:   def pbLastInTeam(idxBattler)
419:     party       = pbParty(idxBattler)
420:     partyOrders = pbPartyOrder(idxBattler)
421:     idxPartyStart, idxPartyEnd = pbTeamIndexRangeFromBattlerIndex(idxBattler)
422:     ret = -1
423:     party.each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
424:       next if i < idxPartyStart || i >= idxPartyEnd   # Check the team only
425:       next if !pkmn || !pkmn.able?   # Can't copy a non-fainted Pokémon or egg
426:       ret = i if ret < 0 || partyOrders[i] > partyOrders[ret]
427:     end
428:     return ret
429:   end

431:   # Used to calculate money gained/lost after winning/losing a battle.
432:   def pbMaxLevelInTeam(side, idxTrainer)
433:     ret = 1
434:     eachInTeam(side, idxTrainer) do |pkmn, _i|
435:       ret = pkmn.level if pkmn.level > ret
436:     end
437:     return ret
438:   end
